# Sabita Traders (full content) – authorised John Deere tractor dealer, Berhampur (Ganjam, Odisha)

> Sabita Traders is the authorised John Deere tractor dealer in Brahmapur (Berhampur), Ganjam district, Odisha, India. Tractor sales, loans, old-tractor exchange, a John Deere service workshop and genuine parts are at one site.

## Key facts
- Address: NH5 Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, Odisha 760007, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89085 89085 (second phone: +91 93375 00337)
- Email: 1sabitatraders@gmail.com
- Open: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM (closed Sunday)
- Areas served: Berhampur, Aska, Bhanjanagar and the rest of Ganjam district
- Tractors: John Deere 5039D PowerPro 2WD (41 HP), 5045D PowerPro (46 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5050D (50 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5105 (40 HP, 2WD and 4WD)
- Finance partners (11): John Deere Financial India Pvt Ltd, State Bank of India, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank, HDFC Bank, DCB Bank, Shriram Finance, Sundaram Finance, L&T Finance, Cholamandalam Finance
- Warranty: John Deere tractors carry a 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, free and transferable, valid with scheduled service at an authorised workshop
- Tractor prices are not published; prices are quoted on request on WhatsApp +91 89085 89085. EMI and exchange values from the website calculators are indicative

### Questions farmers ask.

Which John Deere tractor suits paddy and wet land?

The 5045D PowerPro™ 4WD (46 HP) is our best seller in Ganjam. John Deere fits the 4WD version with high-lug tyres for wet land, and also makes a Puddling Special version. We will suggest the right one for your land on a test drive.

Can I take a loan and the Odisha subsidy together?

Yes, under the Odisha DBT farm mechanisation scheme. Start your loan file before booking on the Go-Sugam portal: your bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit window. Our team helps with both.

What warranty comes with a John Deere tractor?

5 years or 5,000 hours, free and transferable, as long as the tractor is serviced on schedule. Accessories and optional attachments are covered separately.

Where can I service my tractor?

At our workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM. WhatsApp 89085 89085 to book.

## John Deere 5045D PowerPro™

The John Deere 5045D PowerPro™ is a 46 HP D Series tractor, available in 2WD and 4WD. The 4WD version, with high-lug tyres for wet land, is our best seller in Ganjam. It is built for ploughing, tilling and haulage. Get the on-road price and EMI at Sabita Traders, Berhampur.

Choose drive4WD: the front wheels also drive; bigger 8.0 x 18 front tyres. Our best seller for wet land in Ganjam.

Dry land and haulage (2WD)

Ploughing and tilling

### Questions about the 5045D PowerPro™

What is the on-road price of the 5045D PowerPro™ in Ganjam?

Prices vary by variant (2WD or 4WD), tyres and current offers, so we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

What is the difference between the 5045D 2WD and 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels, which are bigger (8.0 x 18 against 6.0 x 16 on the 2WD) for more grip. John Deere lists a dual clutch on the 4WD and a single or dual clutch on the 2WD.

Who should choose the 5045D 2WD?

Farmers who work mainly on dry land, grow rabi crops, or use the tractor for sugarcane haulage and trolley transport. The 2WD usually costs less, is simpler and cheaper to maintain, and turns easily.

Is the 5045D PowerPro™ good for paddy puddling?

Yes. John Deere makes a 5045D PowerPro Puddling Special 4WD for wet paddy fields, and the 4WD version is our best seller for wet land in Ganjam. We help you choose on a test drive.

What is the EMI on the 5045D PowerPro™?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

Where can I service the 5045D PowerPro™ near me?

At our authorised John Deere workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Berhampur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM.

## John Deere 5105

The John Deere 5105 is a 40 HP tractor that John Deere describes as suitable for both dry and wet farming. Its 3-cylinder, 2900 cc engine runs at 2100 RPM with high torque for heavy loads. It comes in 2WD and 4WD. Get the on-road price and EMI at Sabita Traders, Berhampur.

### Questions about the 5105

What is the on-road price of the 5105 in Ganjam?

Prices vary by variant (2WD or 4WD), tyres and current offers, so we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

What is the difference between the 5105 2WD and 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels, which are bigger (8.0 x 18 against 6.0 x 16 on the 2WD) for more grip.

Who should choose the 5105 2WD?

Farmers who work mainly on dry land, grow rabi crops, or use the tractor for sugarcane haulage and trolley transport. The 2WD usually costs less, is simpler and cheaper to maintain, and turns easily.

Can I use the 5105 2WD in wet paddy fields?

For wet paddy, puddling and soft land, the 4WD gives much better grip and is less likely to get stuck. If you do both dry and wet work, choose the 4WD if your budget allows, or ask us about the 5105 Puddling Special.

Is the 5105 good for paddy puddling?

John Deere makes a 5105 Puddling Special version for paddy fields. See its leaflet on this page, or ask us for a demo.

What is the EMI on the 5105?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

Where can I service the 5105 near me?

At our authorised John Deere workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Berhampur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM.

### Questions about the 5039D PowerPro™ 2WD

What is the on-road price of the 5039D PowerPro™ in Ganjam?

Prices vary by variant, tyres and current offers, so we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

Is the 5039D available in 4WD?

John Deere India lists the 5039D PowerPro as a 2WD tractor. For wet paddy work, see the 5045D PowerPro 4WD or the 5105 4WD.

What does PowerPro mean?

PowerPro models have a dual clutch and dual PTO. The dual clutch lets you stop the tractor without stopping the PTO, so implements such as a rotavator keep running.

What is the EMI on the 5039D PowerPro™?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

Where can I service the 5039D PowerPro™ near me?

At our authorised John Deere workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Berhampur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM.

### Documents for a tractor loan

Typical list. Your financier may ask for more; our team will tell you exactly what to bring.

Aadhaar card and PAN card

Land records

Bank passbook or recent statements

Passport-size photographs

Address proof

### Odisha DBT subsidy: how it works

1. Register on Krushak Odisha with your Aadhaar, land details and mobile number.
2. Apply for the machine on the Government's farm-machinery DBT portal. Our team helps you through each step.
3. If you take a loan, start the loan file before booking. The permit is valid for 45 days in loan cases.
4. After delivery and verification, the subsidy is paid to your Aadhaar-linked bank account.

Step-by-step guides: loan, DBT, insurance, RTO ›

### Finance questions

How much down payment do I need?

It depends on the financier, the loan amount they approve and your documents. Try the EMI calculator above, then ask us for quotes from our partners.

Can I get a loan and the Odisha subsidy together?

Yes. Start the loan file before booking. In loan cases the permit is valid for 45 days, and the bank must issue the delivery order within that time.

How long does loan approval take?

It varies by financier and by how complete your documents are. Bring the full document list to avoid delays.

Can I use my old tractor as the down payment?

Yes. Get an indicative value on our Exchange page. We confirm the final price after an on-field inspection and detailed valuation.

### How exchange works.

1

#### Check the value here

Get an indicative range in one minute.

2

#### Send it on WhatsApp

Your details reach our team with one tap. Add 2–3 photos of the tractor.

3

#### Free inspection

We check the tractor at your village or our showroom.

4

#### Written offer

The confirmed value becomes your down payment on a new John Deere.

### What changes the value.

Age matters most. Then hours run, condition, tyres and papers. A well-kept tractor with its service record and RC always gets a better price.

* **Age**Biggest factor; value falls fastest in the first 5 years
* **Hours run**High hours for its age lower the value
* **Condition**Leaks, smoke and repairs lower the value
* **Tyres**Worn tyres are deducted at replacement cost
* **Papers**RC is required; a service record helps

### Your 5-year John Deere warranty

John Deere tractors carry a **5-year / 5,000-hour** warranty. It is free and transferable, and it stays valid when you service your tractor on schedule at an authorised John Deere workshop.

Accessories and optional attachments are covered separately. See John Deere India's warranty terms for details.

FARMER GUIDES

### From choosing a tractor to owning it.

Tap a step in your buying journey to read how it works.

FINANCE

#### How a tractor loan works

Most farmers buy with a loan. The bank or finance company pays the dealer, you pay a down payment, and you repay in instalments. Until the loan is closed, the lender’s name is noted on your tractor’s RC.

1. 1

   **Choose and get a quotation**
   Pick the tractor and implement with the dealer and take a written quotation.
2. 2

   **Apply to a lender**
   John Deere Financial, a bank or an NBFC checks your documents, credit history, land and farm income.
3. 3

   **Sanction and delivery order**
   Once sanctioned, the lender issues a delivery order and pays the dealer. You pay the down payment.
4. 4

   **Take delivery**
   The lender is recorded on the RC as hypothecation: you own and use the tractor; it is security for the loan.
5. 5

   **Repay**
   Pay instalments on time. Farm loans may offer quarterly or half-yearly instalments; ask your lender.
6. 6

   **Close and clear the RC**
   After the last instalment, get the lender’s NOC and apply with Form 35 to remove hypothecation from the RC.

DOCUMENTS USUALLY ASKED FOR

Aadhaar card
PAN card
Land records
Bank statements
Photographs
Address proof

GOOD TO KNOW

* Taking the Odisha DBT subsidy with a loan? Start the loan file before booking, because the bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit.
* Paying on time keeps your credit record clean for future loans.
* Keep the NOC and loan-closure letter safely.

Sources: TractorJunction loan guide; Indian Bank farm machinery loan terms; Bajaj Finserv hypothecation guide; Govt of Odisha DBT-FM operational modality.
See finance options

ODISHA GOVERNMENT · FARM MECHANISATION

#### Government schemes for Ganjam farmers.

Tractors and implements bought under these schemes are subsidised through Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation programme. Every district, Ganjam included, gets a yearly target for each machine. Subsidy amounts are set by the Government of Odisha.

ODISHA STATE PLAN
**Popularisation of Agricultural Implements, Equipment and Diesel Pump Sets**
The state’s main farm mechanisation scheme: tractors, rotavators, power tillers, combine harvesters and post-harvest machines. Extended by the Odisha Cabinet for 2026-27 to 2030-31.

GOVT OF INDIA · PM-RKVY
**Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanisation (SMAM)**
Central scheme for implements such as power tillers, rotavators, transplanters, threshers, balers and drones. Higher assistance for SC, ST, small and marginal, and women farmers.

GOVT OF INDIA
**National Food Security Mission (NFSM)**
Also funds farm machinery under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation programme.

ODISHA · MISSION SHAKTI
**Machinery for Women’s SHGs**
Women’s self-help groups can start agri-ventures by buying farm machinery, applying through a nominated member.

LATEST FROM THE AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT

1 SEP 2026
**New booking round.** Bookings reopened phase-wise from 1 September 2026 after the target top-up.

25 AUG 2026
**Subsidy through Aadhaar.** Subsidy is now paid through the Aadhaar-Based Payment System. Link your Aadhaar to your bank account.

AUG 2026
**Scheme extended to 2031.** The Odisha Cabinet extended the state farm mechanisation scheme for five more years.

FY 2026-27
**New FM-DBT portal.** Farm machinery booking moved to fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in from this financial year.

NOV 2025
**e-RUPI vouchers.** Eligible purchases can be paid with e-RUPI vouchers through onboarded dealers.

ON THE 2026-27 LIST, FOR GANJAM’S CROPS
